 US President Donald Trump has ruled out imminent military action against Iran, telling reporters on Sunday that “there will not be a strike today”.
 US Central Command (CENTCOM) says more than 3,000 commercial vessels have crossed the Strait of Hormuz with the help of American forces over the past six months.
